title: docs(gates): five gates exist only to hold a count re-typed in prose (lockstep "110 packages", route-ledger "105 rows", quick-reference "N of M", overlay-whitelist leg 3, spec-enumerations) — delete or generate the numbers, retire the holders
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Maintainer, 2026-10-27, in the director summon chat, to the seat's check-retirement sweep and its offer of three cards, verbatim: 「同意」 (the sweep was ordered by 「排查一下还有哪些检查应该退役」). Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, sweep record 6433263738). ⛔ Not a claim. Batch-of: 11 (director seat, 2026-10-27). Dedupe: 600 newest open + closed issues grepped for the check's file name → 0 unless stated. Part of #26431. Reader: `domain:devx` (docs gates under `scripts/`; the prose lives in `content/docs/**` and two script headers).

**Measured** (`origin/main` `e677770a`): `scripts/check-lockstep-package-count.mjs` holds the prose "110 packages" in `content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx:199` and `scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs:36` to `.changeset/config.json` (the real invariant is `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`); `scripts/check-route-ledger-census.mjs` holds the sentence "this list holds 105 rows" at `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts:280`; `scripts/check-quick-reference-counts.mjs` holds "(N of M schemas)" headings in `content/docs/getting-started/quick-reference.mdx` (changed 5× in 30 days); `scripts/check-overlay-whitelist-table.mjs` leg 3 holds two registry counts in `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` (legs 1–2 compare the table itself and stay); `scripts/check-docs-spec-enumerations.mjs` holds hand lists of spec subpaths. All carry `--fix`, i.e. the prose is already treated as generated output.

**Wanted:** for each — remove the number from the prose (a sentence that does not state a count cannot drift) or render it at build time from the authority; then retire the holder script, its `pnpm check:*` entry and its lint.yml step (Tier H for the workflow line: lands by the maintainer's approval). Legs 1–2 of the overlay-whitelist gate stay. **Acceptance:** none of the five counts appears as a literal in `content/docs` or a script header; the five `check:*` scripts are gone from `package.json` and `lint.yml`; `check-doc-links`, `docs-audit` green. **Size:** M (one PR, or one per gate). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
